# anthropic_claude_tag_slack_channels (Data Source)

Experimental. Lists the channels of one Slack workspace that are set up for Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) (`/v1/organizations/claude_tag/slack_channels`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_claude_tag_slack_channels" "example" {
  slack_workspace_id = "T00000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slack_workspace_id` (String) Slack's own workspace identifier (`T...`), not the Claude Tag workspace `id`.

### Optional

- `include_inherited` (Boolean) When `true`, settings hold what applies once the settings levels above are taken into account, instead of only what is stored at this level.
- `slack_channel_id` (String) Optional filter: Slack's own channel identifier (`C...` or `G...`). Returns that channel alone, or nothing when it is not set up.

### Read-Only

- `channels` (Attributes List) Set-up channels of the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--channels))

<a id="nestedatt--channels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `channels`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when it was set up.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Claude is on. `true` on a channel turns Claude on even when its workspace stores `false`. Null means not stored here (inherited).
- `environment_id` (String) Environment Claude's sessions run in (`env_...`) or a self-hosted runner pool (`ccpool_...`). Null means not stored here (inherited).
- `guest_policy` (String) What Claude does while a Slack guest is in the channel: `allow`, `restrict`, or `channel_only`. Null means not stored here (inherited).
- `id` (String) Claude Tag channel identifier (`slch_...`).
- `instructions` (String) Instructions for Claude, up to 8,192 characters. Instructions add up across settings levels, broadest first. Null means none stored here.
- `model` (String) Model identifier or model line name Claude uses. Null means not stored here (inherited).
- `reply_mode` (String) How Claude takes part in the channel: `automatic`, `mention_only`, `always_awake`, or `thread`. Null when the channel stores none.
- `slack_channel_id` (String) Slack's own channel identifier (`C...` or `G...`), not the Claude Tag channel `id`.
- `slack_workspace_id` (String) Slack's own workspace identifier (`T...`), not the Claude Tag workspace `id`.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last change to Claude Tag's record of it.
